scope: Device identification cards only. No operational commissioning, wiring or interoperability guarantee is inferred from shared appearance.
image_processing: Original manufacturer pixels; alpha flattened onto white, maximum 1200 px, WebP quality 93. PDF illustrations extracted by exact image XRef from inspected page 1. No generated imagery.

devices.model_evidence: Multipoint ASD family illustration from the exact installation sheet. The codes distinguish detector-only, integral sounder and sounder/strobe versions.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Twinflex family only, not Sita 205-series. The pictured housing alone does not establish the sounder/strobe option; an integral strobe is not assumed to be an EN54-23 VAD.

devices.model_evidence: Manufacturer family illustration shows Sita Multipoint ASD heads. Read the 205-series code to identify detector-only, sounder or sounder/strobe equipment.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Sita addressable family, not Twinflex 204-series. The common housing and family picture cannot prove the fitted options or panel compatibility.

devices.model_evidence: Red resettable indoor call point illustrated with its test/reset key. The rear label is needed to distinguish Twinflex from similar Sita units.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: 402-0006 indoor model. The same manual includes weatherproof 402-0007; that deeper enclosure is not the pictured device.

devices.model_evidence: Red Sita Mk3 indoor call point from its exact manual. Similar Twinflex fronts require a label check, not a visual compatibility decision.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: 403-0006 only. The sheet also covers weatherproof 403-0007; it is a different enclosure. This entry does not describe Twinflex 402-series call points.

devices.model_evidence: Grey Twinflex input/output interface faceplate, shown in the manufacturer installation instructions. Confirm the 802-0006 code.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Twinflex zone interface only; visually similar Sita 803-0006 is an addressable-loop device. Circuit functions depend on the matched manual and panel configuration.

devices.model_evidence: Grey Sita input/output interface shown in the exact 803-0006 installation sheet. Read the label before distinguishing it from Twinflex.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Sita loop I/O, not the 802-0006 Twinflex interface. The pictured faceplate does not identify the programmed input/output behaviour.

devices.model_evidence: Red circular sounder/VAD with a central clear lens and lower fixing screw, illustrated in document 26-1878-04.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Twinflex sounder/VAD only, distinct from sounder-only F0296337. Correct orientation and coverage are specified by the installation manual.

devices.model_evidence: Red SoundPoint faceplate sounder with a lower grille. Image is from the Sita SoundPoint installation sheet.
devices.protocol_and_variant_limits: Red 313-0001 model. White 313-0002 shares the sheet; Twinflex SoundPoint 313-0021/0022 uses a different system and is not covered by this card.

review_notes: Every picture is extracted from page 1 of the exact Fike installation PDF and visually inspected. Archive records were previously listed without hashes; retrieved hashes and pages are recorded here without changing the catalogue.
Twinflex and Sita detector, MCP and I/O housing similarities are explicitly disclosed; their different two-wire/addressable systems have separate cards.
MCP entries cover indoor 402-0006 and 403-0006 only. Weatherproof variants appear in their manuals but are not implied by the pictured indoor image.
Multipoint integral strobe variants are not described as VADs. F0296336 is the separately documented Twinflex sounder/VAD.
visual_review: Each final card image was inspected on the per-brand contact sheet and compared with its source product page or manufacturer PDF illustration. Shared housing, assembled-head/base and edition limitations were retained.
